## UI polish: Empty-state card 13 fixes across spacing, typography, hierarchy, layout, states, motion and tokens. Text and brand hue kept. Tokens from tokens.css. ### Fixes 1. **Spacing**: `.empty` `padding: 20px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-24)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 2. **Spacing**: `h2` `margin: 0 0 6px` is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 0 var(--space-8)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 3. **Spacing**: `p` `margin: 0 0 18px` is off the scale. Now `margin: 0 auto var(--space-16)`. The `auto` keeps the narrower paragraph centred. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 4. **Spacing**: `button` `padding: 8px 14px` is off the scale. Now `padding: var(--space-8) var(--space-16)`. (R-ui-polish-1, R-ui-polish-20) 5. **Typography**: `p` `font-size: 15px` is off the scale and below the 16 px body minimum. Now `font-size: var(--font-size-md)`. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-20) 6. **Typography**: `p` had no line-height and no max-width. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-body); max-width: var(--measure)`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 7. **Typography**: `h2` had no line-height. Now `line-height: var(--line-height-heading)`. (R-ui-polish-3, R-ui-polish-20) 8. **Typography**: the `h2` used the browser's default weight of 700, which has no token, and the `button` used the browser's default font (about 13.33 px). Now `h2` uses `font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)`. The button uses `font-family: inherit; font-size: var(--font-size-md); line-height: var(--line-height-body); font-weight: var(--font-weight-strong)`. The page now uses two weights, 400 and 600. (R-ui-polish-2, R-ui-polish-8, R-ui-polish-20) 9. **Hierarchy**: the one primary action, "New project", used raw `#0f766e` / `#fff`. Now it uses `var(--color-action-primary-bg)` / `var(--color-action-primary-text)`. The values are the same, so the ratio stays 5.47:1. (R-ui-polish-5, R-ui-polish-21) 10. **Layout**: the button was about 34 px tall, below the target minimum. Now `min-height: var(--size-target-min); min-width: var(--size-target-min)`. (R-ui-polish-7, R-ui-polish-20) 11. **States**: the button had no hover, pressed, focus or disabled style. Now it has these: - hover: `var(--color-action-primary-bg-hover)` - active: `var(--color-action-primary-bg-pressed)` - `:focus-visible`: `outline: var(--border-width-focus) solid var(--color-border-focus); outline-offset: 2px` - `:disabled`: `opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed` (R-ui-polish-6, R-ui-polish-20) 12. **Motion**: added `transition: background-color var(--duration-base) var(--ease-standard)` on the button. A `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` block turns it off. (R-ui-polish-9, R-ui-polish-20) 13. **Tokens**: swapped raw values that have the same value as a token: - `#ffffff` → `var(--color-surface-default)` - `#202d2c` → `var(--color-text-default)` - `#9ca3af` → `var(--color-text-muted)` - `border-radius: 6px` → `var(--radius-control)` - `font-family: system-ui` → `var(--font-family-sans)` (R-ui-polish-20) ### Contrast | Text | Before | After | |------|--------|-------| | Heading "No projects yet" | #202d2c on #ffffff, 14.26:1 | `--color-text-default` (#202d2c) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 14.26:1 | | Description | #9ca3af on #ffffff, 2.54:1 | `--color-text-muted` (#9ca3af) on `--color-surface-default` (#ffffff), 2.54:1, fails | | "New project" button | #ffffff on #0f766e, 5.47:1 | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg` (#0f766e), 5.47:1 | | "New project" button, hover | none | `--color-action-primary-text` (#ffffff) on `--color-action-primary-bg-hover` (#0c403c), 11.58:1 | Ratios computed with the contrast script. ### Polished code ```html

No projects yet

Create your first project to get started.

``` ### Not changed - All visible text, word for word. - Brand hue kept: #0f766e (`--color-brand` / `--color-action-primary-bg`). - Token file: not edited. ### Open questions - `--color-text-muted` is 2.54:1 on `--color-surface-default`, so the description fails 4.5:1. The token file needs a darker value, for example `--color-neutral-700` at 6.38:1 or `--color-neutral-600` at 4.55:1, both from `--scale`. Its current `#9ca3af` is also a cool grey that isn't in your teal neutral ramp.
